title: GTA 6: Telegram CEO Says Game's 'Least Realistic Thing' Isn't Bigfoot or Aliens, It's This
excerpt: GTA 6 sees players plan several heists, but Telegram’s CEO has now joked that the game lacks one realistic element. Following the game’s release, Telegram CEO Pavel Durov took to social media to joke ...
content:
GTA 6 sees players plan several heists, but Telegram's CEO has now joked that the game lacks one realistic element. Following the game's release, Telegram CEO Pavel Durov took to social media to joke about the protagonists not using the messaging service to coordinate their operations.

"The least realistic thing about GTA VI is that Jason and Lucia run a whole criminal operation without a single Telegram group," Durov wrote on an X post. Durov's comments come after Telegram was accused of enabling illicit activity on its platform.

Telegram's criminal reputation makes Durov's GTA 6 joke even more ironic

While Durov might have joked about Telegram's association with crime being overlooked in GTA, the service has seen increased global scrutiny. This includes recent bans in Jordan and Iraq over national security concerns.

Durov was also indicted in France on 12 charges of allegedly enabling criminal activity on Telegram in 2024. Following the incident, Telegram made several changes to its policies to curb criminal activities.

Durov has maintained that Telegram does not support such activities and that the service complies with law enforcement authorities where necessary.

Rockstar Games has parodied several real-world companies and services in its latest open-world title. The game's characters use WhatUp, a parody of WhatsApp, to message each other. It also features an in-game social media platform called Snapmatic, which closely resembles Instagram in the real world.

Despite facing controversy, GTA 6 has sold over 33 million copies and grossed more than $3.79 billion worldwide. It has become the biggest product launch in entertainment history, outgrossing hits like Avengers: Endgame in a single day. The game also features some of the biggest names in the music industry, along with several Easter eggs referencing iconic movies.

Grand Theft Auto VI is available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
